description: See a published workflow's steps and whether it is ready to run. Review inputs and use the existing authorized workflow run API to execute. Use after search_workflows to inspect one workflow's steps and readiness. Example arguments: {"template_id": 12} Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.

template_id.description: The workflow id returned by search_workflows.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: workflow_details

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.
